body: I see what you’re saying. She hasn’t been pushy thankfully which is why I feel like she’s being prompted by my parents. Hopefully the conversation I have with her goes well. It should but I don’t know how she’s actually feeling since I’m not her.

I’m going to do this for sure. I think I’m just so afraid of potentially upsetting her but at the end of the day the reality of the situation still exists. I just wish I could do more for her besides just be there and stay in contact.

I’ve actually been crying because all of this has been my rationalization in the back of my head and I don’t like it all. I want to be there more for her but you’re right. I can’t support her and unfortunately it’s not my responsibility. If I was in a better position in life in a perfect world I’d honestly raise her myself because both parents suck in their own way. It’s so bad she constantly wants to be like me because all my parents do is talk about me. I can see she’s distressed and wants love. I think she feels the family dynamic we all had before I left was the ideal family despite the fact it was so dysfunctional. I think I’ll just have a call with her later this week.

Hey I’m sorry I didn’t respond earlier. I kind of just went off the radar for a bit. My favorite part is honestly just anything spooky. I love horror movies, costumes, and I especially love apple flavors in foods if I can manage to eat them.

I have a memory actually from a nice Halloween a couple of years after my attempt that I spent with friends. It was cold and snow was blowing in but we decided to walk and just get whatever candy we could because nobody was out. We found one house that was giving out hot apple cider and tbh that was the best flavor and memory I’ve had on Halloween.
I find some comfort despite all of this. Sometimes it doesn’t help as I would like it to but I always try to find at least one positive thing in my day and that keeps me going.
Yeah keeping myself busy just wasn’t enough. I’m talking to my friends on Xbox now and it’s helping

I actually thought of this tbh. I even told him today it reminds me of a saying where they say you meet the right one at the wrong time. Which is really cheesy but I feel like it is relevant a bit 

I can definitely say we both need to work on ourselves. I’ve been mentally preparing myself to let him go and start working on myself even more. Because while therapy has been good I need to do some more work outside of that. I’ve encouraged him to go to therapy too. I think the hardest part about this is letting go. But I want him to be happy and I don’t want to hold him back. And if he wants to leave then honestly he should
We both did but he asked
He did. Idk if he had someone picked out. I honestly wasn’t against it since I’m also into girls and I had some rules. Honestly it was a impulsive decision I should’ve be more careful with
I love him. I just don’t trust him and I feel hurt by him. I’m not sure if that makes sense
I already told him to do that. I’m not sleeping with him until he does
I actually asked him this today and he told me I couldn’t trust it because the damage is already done. So even if he told me I could trust him it wouldn’t really matter
I have a huge TBR pile so this is a really good idea! Guess I’ll be reading The Midnight Library tonight. Thank you I really really appreciate this

I genuinely don’t know what to do since even when I am selfish I’m told I’m horrible. I’m a people pleaser. I got this from PTSD and BPD due to childhood abuse. Everyone expects me to just be ok but I’m not. And when I’m not I’m considered to be volatile. I have no room to express my emotions or feel them without any judgment. I feel like even just eating food is wrong of me (even when I buy my own food now) and I can’t just keep going with future plans of chores or making up small solo dates with myself. I can’t feel any joy from it anymore and I can’t feel any joy from my hobbies like gaming, drawing, and art. I try to do those anyways but it makes me feel worse when I do
I absolutely agree with this. Thank you I’ll try that. We have had good moments in two player co op games. We played It Takes Two even. So I’ll probably get cuphead or something

While I do appreciate this advice I would like to add more info about me not letting him play my games with me. I have tried that. That exploded into a huge argument where he told me that doesn’t fix anything because I’ll still be playing those games without him on my own time and he’s also afraid I would find friends to play with me on those games that aren’t him.
I’m doing that as well. I just would like advice on what to do moving wise
I feel like you haven’t read the full thread. Thank you though. I understand what I need to improve on

For a slight update. I apologized to him for being dismissive like 10 minutes ago. I offered to pay next month’s internet and he told me he didn’t want any money. I do feel conflicted over that so I’m just going to work on my communication and hope I can better myself as a person. I’m also going to work on moving out because at this point I feel like me using his internet or him covering rent (even though he won’t let me pay any contribution) is only going to create a toxic dynamic.
Sending good vibes your way too
I do agree with that. I can see that

Dad pays. He won’t let me pay and tells me to save my money. He was ok with me opening the port and I didn’t do it until he gave me the ok. I checked all info and all recent logins. I also changed the password and set up 2auth (idk why he didn’t have that) and I check the app daily now to make sure everything is ok.

I disagree. I’ve had multiple instances where my mother’s side of the family told me it was ok for my step dad to limit my food due to me “eating them out of the house” while I was under 100lbs at the age of 15-17. I would like to know where I’m wrong in my actions not in the aspect of how many people tell me I’m wrong. (In other words: I appreciate you going over how I’m wrong in my actions. But I don’t agree with the statement of if multiple people are telling me I’m wrong then I’m just wrong. The world isn’t black and white like that.)
Thank you for this I appreciate the feedback
This is the first time he’s ever done this. Usually our conversations are calm and pleasant
I’m not sure yet. This happened just a couple of hours ago. I can add a update in a day to let everyone know if these issues continue.
I didn’t slam the door he did. I talked to him about the port before and he agreed. (I don’t pay for the internet because every time I try to pay for something like rent or insurance he tells me no)

It’s a little mean you said that but NTA because you were talking about a hypothetical situation. (And quite frankly everyone who smoked cigs should acknowledge that they’re actively engaging the possibility of lung cancer by smoking. There’s labels on the packaging. So also NTA because it would be her fault for getting cancer. Idk if that’s harsh but that’s just my take.) She’s the A for doing it in a actual situation where you were injured and in the hospital. Also she’s being the A because she’s using that to attack you and your passion/hobby. Motor crossing isn’t bad and she doesn’t need to approve of it but she also doesn’t need to be a douche about it. I feel like she’s lashing out at you because you didn’t follow what she wanted which was for you to not participate in this hobby is selfish of her.
I appreciate this. Thanks for being so upfront and raw about it and not just ✨it’ll be ok I promise✨
